notes: Milestones are deterministic. Rotation weights primary-gap skills 2x over secondary. Each template produces one concrete proof artifact. Keep actions under 45 min where possible.

technical.description: Hard skills: languages, frameworks, tools, systems, data, infra.

templates.title: Build a small {skill} artifact
templates.action: Build one small working artifact in {skill} that a reviewer for {job_title} at {company} could scan in under two minutes. Paste link or file path as proof.
templates.proof_prompt: What did you build? What does it demonstrate about your {skill} level?
templates.impact_prompt: Why would a hiring manager at {company} care about this?

templates.title: Read one real {skill} source, reapply it
templates.action: Pick one real engineering post, doc, or commit about {skill}. Summarise the core idea in your own words, then apply it to a problem similar to what {job_title} would face.
templates.proof_prompt: What source? What did you reapply?
templates.impact_prompt: How does this prove you can operate in {skill} at the {job_title} bar?

templates.title: Debug or refactor using {skill}
templates.action: Take broken or messy code relevant to {skill} and fix or refactor it. Note the before/after and the reasoning.
templates.proof_prompt: Paste a diff, screenshot, or short description of the change.
templates.impact_prompt: What risk or inefficiency did this remove?

templates.title: Write a {skill} tradeoff note
templates.action: Write a 150-word note comparing two real approaches in {skill} (libraries, patterns, designs). State which you would pick for {job_title} at {company} and why.
templates.impact_prompt: Which part shows depth a generalist would miss?

templates.title: Run one measurement in {skill}
templates.action: Measure something in {skill}: latency, correctness, coverage, token cost, query plan. Record numbers and what you would change.
templates.proof_prompt: What did you measure? What were the numbers?
templates.impact_prompt: What decision would this measurement drive at {company}?

product.description: Product sense: discovery, prioritisation, specs, metrics, user judgement.

templates.title: Spec one feature for {company}
templates.action: Write a one-page spec for a feature {company} could ship next quarter. Include user, problem, solution, success metric, and one risk. Use {skill} as the lens.
templates.impact_prompt: Which tradeoff did you make that a weaker PM would miss?

templates.title: {company} product teardown through {skill}
templates.action: Pick one surface of {company}'s product. Critique it through {skill}. Give three concrete changes and the expected impact on each.
templates.impact_prompt: Which change is non-obvious?

templates.title: Metric tree for {job_title}
templates.action: Draw the metric tree for a {job_title} at {company}. Mark the one metric you would own and why. Anchor it in {skill}.
templates.proof_prompt: Paste the tree and the chosen metric.
templates.impact_prompt: Why is this metric the highest leverage right now?

templates.title: User research plan using {skill}
templates.action: Write a 5-question user interview plan for a real {company} user segment. Each question must be non-leading and tied to a decision.
templates.impact_prompt: What decision does each question unblock?

communication.description: Writing, presenting, stakeholder alignment, clarity under pressure.

templates.title: One-pager proving {skill}
templates.action: Write a one-page memo a {job_title} at {company} could send tomorrow. Must have: context, recommendation, rationale, and one risk. Keep it under 300 words.
templates.impact_prompt: Which sentence would convince a skeptical reader fastest?

templates.title: Rewrite dense text using {skill}
templates.action: Take one dense paragraph from {company}'s docs, blog, or a real job description. Rewrite it so a new hire understands it in 20 seconds. Preserve meaning.
templates.impact_prompt: What clarity move did you apply?

templates.title: Weekly stakeholder update in {skill}
templates.action: Draft the weekly update a {job_title} would send at {company}. Include: done, next, risks, asks. Keep each section under 3 bullets.
templates.impact_prompt: Which risk would this flag early?

templates.title: Script a hard conversation
templates.action: Write the opening three lines of a hard conversation a {job_title} at {company} might need to hold. Use {skill} principles. No hedging.
templates.impact_prompt: Why do these lines earn trust instead of defensiveness?

leadership.description: Judgement, influence, ownership, decision-making, team craft.

templates.title: Decision memo using {skill}
templates.action: Pick a real tradeoff a {job_title} at {company} might face. Write a 200-word decision memo: options, criteria, decision, reversibility. Anchor it in {skill}.
templates.impact_prompt: Why this decision over the obvious one?

templates.title: Prioritisation grid for {job_title}
templates.action: List 6 real things a {job_title} at {company} could do next quarter. Score each on impact and effort. Pick the top 2 and defend the cut of one.
templates.proof_prompt: Paste the grid and cut rationale.
templates.impact_prompt: Which cut would be uncomfortable and why is it right?

templates.title: Postmortem using {skill}
templates.action: Write a blameless postmortem for a real or realistic failure {company} might have faced. Cover: what happened, detection, impact, root causes, actions.
templates.impact_prompt: Which action prevents recurrence instead of firefighting?

templates.title: First-30-days plan for {job_title}
templates.action: Draft a 30-day plan for your first month as {job_title} at {company}. Three outcomes, five learning targets, two people you would meet weekly. Use {skill}.
templates.impact_prompt: Why are these outcomes achievable in 30 days?

analytics.description: Data analysis, metrics, SQL, experimentation, quantitative reasoning.

templates.title: Write one {skill} query for {company}
templates.action: Write a query in {skill} that answers a real question a {job_title} at {company} would ask. Include the question, the query, and the expected shape of the result.
templates.proof_prompt: Paste the question and the query.
templates.impact_prompt: What action does this answer unlock?

templates.title: Design an A/B test using {skill}
templates.action: Design one A/B test a {job_title} at {company} could run. State hypothesis, metric, sample size logic, and stopping rule.
templates.impact_prompt: Which part prevents a false positive?

templates.title: Funnel breakdown with {skill}
templates.action: Sketch a funnel for a {company} product flow. Mark the step you would investigate first and the {skill} method you would use.
templates.proof_prompt: Paste the funnel and the method.
templates.impact_prompt: Why that step first?

templates.title: Data quality audit using {skill}
templates.action: Pick one dataset you can access. Run a quality audit using {skill}: completeness, freshness, duplicates, outliers. Report three concrete findings.
templates.impact_prompt: Which finding would a {job_title} at {company} act on first?

templates.title: Short forecast via {skill}
templates.action: Build a 4-week forecast for one metric relevant to {job_title} at {company}. State method, assumptions, and confidence range.
templates.impact_prompt: Which assumption is the riskiest?

rules: Rotate so no skill repeats two days in a row unless only one target is selected.
When multiple targets exist, pick weighted-random from remaining-for-week pool.
If a skill has no matching family, fall back to 'technical' for hard skills or 'communication' for soft skills.
Cap one milestone per day; never stack.
